extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF text and figure captions; no direct mechanism assay is promoted from background rationale.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper directly supports antibacterial phenotype for [R4W4], levofloxacin/levofloxacin-Q, peptide-drug conjugates, and physical mixtures by MIC assay against MRSA and Klebsiella pneumoniae.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC activity is a phenotype endpoint, not a direct membrane, uptake, gyrase, or target-engagement mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The AMP/cell-penetrating-peptide rationale is that cationic amphiphilic [R4W4] may help penetration or membrane interaction, but this paper uses that as background/rationale and does not directly assay membrane permeabilization.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not classify as direct_mechanism for this paper; no membrane permeability, uptake, or lipopolysaccharide interaction assay was recovered locally.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Levofloxacin is described as a fluoroquinolone that inhibits topoisomerase IV and DNA gyrase; this is cited background for the drug, not a new direct mechanism experiment in this paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No topoisomerase, DNA gyrase, or nucleic-acid binding assay was performed for the conjugates in local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Local XML/PDF/OA package review did not recover direct mechanism assays, toxicity tables, hemolysis tables, or separate supplementary mechanism data for this paper.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: all reported compounds in this paper
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism layer is publication-grade only as a bounded negative/directness adjudication; it should not be expanded to direct membrane or nucleic-acid mechanism claims.
